in_hebrew.name: גברין
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word 'gabar' meaning 'strong' and the suffix '-in' meaning 'man'. This name can be translated as 'strong man' or 'man of power'.

in_greek.name: Γερών
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'geron' meaning 'old man, ancient, hero, warrior'. This name can be translated as 'man' or 'hero'.

in_latin.name: Gervinus
in_latin.meaning: Germanic name of 'Gervas' with the suffix '-inus'.
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Old High German word 'giswara' meaning 'pledge, hostage' and the suffix '-inus' meaning 'belonging to'. This name can be translated as 'pledge man' or 'hostage man'.
